method: Evaluated unsimplified source triangles; exact BVH triangle overlap, bounded bidirectional nearest-normal penetration samples (not exhaustive volume certification); axial contact ray casts and radial guide rays.
limitations: Open spring ends make signed containment unreliable for spring target; report spring surface crossings separately.
Switch actuator is a compliant nominal placeholder; actuator entering the switch body is expected and not a solid-material certification.
Spring stiffness, switch rated travel and friction cannot be measured from mesh geometry.
